The failure was caused by the word "input" in comments, which tripped the forbidden-construct filter. I removed it and also simplified the error prediction. The topology is a low-voltage cascode mirror with resistor self-bias.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),   # bottom mirror devices gm/Id
    "L_b":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),      # bottom L (matching, ro)
    "gmid_c": (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),   # cascode gm/Id (weak inversion -> small Vdsat)
    "L_c":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),      # cascode L
    "vx":     (0.15, 0.11, 0.22),   # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vx = p["vx"]

    # bottom devices: identical (ratio 1), both at Vds = vx
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], I, vds=vx)
    # cascodes: source at vx (body effect), drain side sees roughly vout - vx
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=vout - vx, vsb=vx)

    # Self-bias: V(nb) = Vgs_b ; V(iin) = V(nb) + I*R ; Vx = V(iin) - Vgs_c
    R = (vx - mb.vgs + mc.vgs) / I
    R = max(R, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # reference branch
    n.R("R1", "iin", "nb", R)                         # top of R biases cascode gates
    n.dev("MC1", "nb", "iin", "x1", "vss", mc)        # reference-side cascode
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)         # reference mirror device, gate at nb
    # output branch
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", mc)      # output cascode
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)         # output mirror device

    # predictions
    gmc = mc.gm + mc.gmbs
    rout = gmc / (mc.gds * mb.gds)
    vcomp = vx + mc.vdsat
    # systematic error: Vds difference of bottom devices due to finite cascode gain
    vnb = mb.vgs
    dvx = (vout - vnb) * mc.gds / gmc
    err = abs(dvx) * mb.gds / I * 100 + 0.5   # + mismatch/corner allowance
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp,
               "power": 2 * I * 1.8}
```
